Game value (Reizwert)

Source: R/bidding.R
sk_game_value.Rd

Computes the value of a declared game: for suit and grand games, the base value times the multiplier (matadors + 1, plus one for game, plus levels for hand, schneider, schwarz, ouvert as announced). Null games use their fixed values.

Usage

sk_game_value(
  hand,
  game_type,
  hand_game = FALSE,
  schneider = FALSE,
  schwarz = FALSE,
  ouvert = FALSE,
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

Arguments

hand

An sk_card object or character vector: the declarer's cards used for matador counting.

game_type

A single game-type string, one of sk_game_types().

hand_game

Logical; TRUE if played as a hand game (skat not picked up). Defaults to FALSE.

schneider

Logical; announced schneider. Defaults to FALSE.

schwarz

Logical; announced schwarz. Defaults to FALSE.

ouvert

Logical; open (ouvert) game. Defaults to FALSE.

call

The calling environment, used for error reporting.

Value

A single integer game value. Null games return one of the four fixed values 23, 35, 46, or 59.

See also

sk_matadors() for the multiplier and sk_score_game() for what a game value is worth once played.

Other bidding functions: sk_base_value(), sk_matadors()

Examples

sk_game_value(c("CJ", "SJ", "HA", "HK", "H10", "H9"), "hearts")
#> [1] 30
sk_game_value(character(0), "null")
#> [1] 23
sk_game_value(character(0), "null", hand_game = TRUE, ouvert = TRUE)
#> [1] 59
